3499-4770-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2438-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2438-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2034-2415-6094.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2073-5256-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-5256-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5088-5211-6798-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
5088-5211-6798-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Umbra Collar Zealot by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, surveiling 1.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Umbra Collar Zealot by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, surveiling 1.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

4050-5058-7396.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5359-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5359-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-5256-7191.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

3291-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 2.

3129-5524-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-5524-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Destiny Spinner
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

147-997-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1494-6971.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five experience counters.
1494-6971.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Kratos's second ability triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

339-677-6798-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

465-2511-3817.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-1659-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2634-4973-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-4973-5148.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

224-225-1772-5233.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-1772-5233.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

813-961-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Against All Odds.
813-961-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1202-1737-3967-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

3765-5858-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-5858-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-5858-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

11-3528-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-3528-5131-6276.description:
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Rise of the Eldrazi.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Rise of the Eldrazi, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Rise of the Eldrazi, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3528-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-2719-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces has a power of at least 2.
2713-2719-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

338-2060-3490-3910-4094.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-3490-3910-4094.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional artifacts.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
338-2060-3490-3910-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

796-2440-3940-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Zombies.
796-2440-3940-4050.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher and Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying Haze of Rage for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve each Haze of Rage, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each Haze of Rage and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1335-2034-2127-4153.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2034-2127-4153.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Tribute to the World Tree triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Elemental.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elemental dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and +1/+1 counters on Marath, you may use its ability to deal infinite damage and/or get creature tokens or +1/+1 counters.

1887-2713-5115.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

969-3259-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
969-3259-3590.description:
Declare Warchanter Skald and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dwarf Berserker token, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2035-2523-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Gollum's power.
Repeat.

2816-2916-4321-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Pippin does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Pippin.
2816-2916-4321-4659.description:
Activate Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pippin by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2445-2571-4490-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2445-2571-4490-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
If Devoted Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it, repeat from step 1 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's outlast ability by paying {G} and tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

3764-4050-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1263-3602-4050-5296.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and goading it.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2111-3466-4802.description:
Cast Wingrattle Scarecrow by paying {3}.
Wingrattle Scarecrow enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Reaper King triggers, destroying Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

643-1486-3337-3908.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of other Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1447-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi, targeting Angel of Glory's Rise.
Sacrifice Angel of Glory's Rise to Phyrexian Altar adding one mana of any color.
Saffi's delayed trigger returns Angel of Glory's Rise to the battlefield.
Angel of Glory's Rise's trigger returns Saffi to the battlefield.
Repeat.
